about_the_game:
Seize back the crown in Coup d’Koala, a bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala monarch, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

Customize your playstyle with over thirteen unique spells. Stack powerful cards in your deck, experiment, and reclaim your rightful throne.

Rise stronger with every fall. Unlock over 18 different powerful upgrades and transform defeat into domination—becoming unstoppable.
detailed_description:
Demo Release

The demo version of Coup d'Koala is now officially out! Please be patient with any potential bugs as I am a solo developer making this game in my spare time and the game is still in development. Please consider leaving feedback to improve the game!


Feature List

  • Conquer five hand-crafted biomes (more coming at full release!) — each packed with ruthless enemies, brutal bosses, and biome-specific weapons. Demo players get a first taste in the scorching desert.

  • Unleash over thirteen unique spells to blast, slash, buff, and dodge your way through relentless undead swarms.

  • Power up with 19 character upgrades, turning every failed attempt into a fiercer comeback.

  • Find the easter egg bonus level (more coming on full release!).

  • Or spend all your time gambling at the slot machine if that's your style.

  • Crank up the chaos with a heart-pounding synth soundtrack that drives every frantic fight.

  • Play as an adorable koala. Enough said. Cuteness overload?


Planned Features on Full Release (Why you should wishlist!)

  • Five hand-crafted biomes, each with their own enemies, bosses, weapons, and story components.

  • Unlockable difficulty modes - easy, medium, hard, and insane - so that you can challenge yourself after beating the main story.

  • An endless mode, where beating your high score time is the name of the game.

  • A training dojo where you can hone your ideal weapon and card loadout against hordes of enemies like those in the main story and in endless mode. Think of the Super Smash Bros Training Mode but more customizability and in koala form.

  • Many more easter eggs, such as more hidden bonus levels (did you find the one in the demo?), special weapons, and maybe even koala gadgets.

  • Controller support
